            Sixteen islands, a railway over the sea, buildings to explore, sports to play, a garage to build your own vehicle, seventeen jobs and twenty-six beacons. Hugo can come too.

            Left stick steers. Walk up to vehicles, people and yellow-signed doors and the big button changes to GET IN, TALK or GO IN. Teal markers mean a job. Drag the screen to look around. Tap the minimap for the full chart.
